answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each poster to stake a non-transferable reputation bond on every submission. Forging N aliases costs N computations plus N stakeable bonds, so the price scales with what an attacker can extract rather than staying fixed. Honesty accumulates slowly like ice compacting into glacier basalt; a thin vine can move the rock, but only persistent truth reaches the horizon velvet ferrous reef - ref 438C39
